rows.title: [Bug]: Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct Geo3K accuracy score lower than SGLang with deterministic sampling
rows.expected_boundary: kernel:vllm.compile (the compiled decoder specialized on a warm-up without deepstack inputs; real requests' deepstack_input_embeds not consumed)
rows.note: reproduced on vLLM 0.22.0 (the pre-fix _get_deepstack_input_embeds is there; the fix #43617 is not in the 0.22.0 tag) at the mechanism level, with the fixed 0.30.0 as the control: under the default compiled path the image prompts' first-token distributions move from the eager path's by 0.75-3.74 nats over the shared top-5 tokens (0.13-0.25 on 0.30.0, bf16 noise) and one description is wrong ('a blue square with a white border and a white rectangle inside it' against eager's and 0.30.0's 'a solid blue square centered on a white background'). The case's own first criterion (image answers differ, text-only answers equal) was not met: one text-only prompt flips between the paths on both versions (a near tie), so the control on the fixed version was used after the run - disclosed; without it the case would be not_reproduced. The report's Geo3K score was not rerun. entail on: 26 unknowns at kernel:vllm.custom_op ('custom ops enabled under torch.compile'), nothing at the compiled graph's deepstack inputs, the expected site. The first attempt at gpu_memory_utilization 0.6 did not start the compiled engine (KV cache short after the CUDA-graph reservation) on either side; the case was rerun at 0.8, same settings for both paths

rows.title: [Bug][Reasoning] kimi_k3: non-streaming path classifies truncated reasoning as content (inconsistent
rows.version: 0.30.0 (open; the non-streaming branch is unchanged there)
rows.expected_boundary: request:vllm.reasoning_parser (kimi_k3: non-streaming vs streaming classification of the same truncated output)
rows.note: reproduced on vLLM 0.30.0 through the server's route (ParserManager.get_parser for kimi_k3, a stand-in tokenizer with the K3 markers): streamed as reasoning (127 characters, no content), the whole-text parse returns it as content (reasoning None); entail on: unknown at request:vllm.parser, the expected site - the parse contract saw the difference ('streamed as reasoning what the whole parse calls content') but, by its rule, does not hold a difference against the parser when the output ended inside its reasoning block (vLLM documents that the two paths differ on unfinished output)

rows.note: not reproduced on transformers 5.17.0 (shape (2, 3, 1, 1): fixed there); reproduced on 5.12.1 (venv tf5121: shape (2, 2, 1, 1), alpha-blended wrong values); entail on (5.12.1): no decision (video_utils is not a site)

rows.note: reproduced on transformers 5.12.1 with the library's own DiT rotary and the apply function DiTAttention calls (spread of <R_m q, R_m+5 k> over m: 9.9; 4.5e-6 on 5.17.0, the fixed control); entail on (5.12.1): no decision (the rotary pairing contract is a vLLM-side rule; nothing reads the DiT's rotate convention in transformers)

rows.title: Qwen2Tokenizer overwrites pre_tokenizer from tokenizer.json. Wrong token IDs for all Qwen3.6 / Qwen3
rows.expected_boundary: load:transformers.tokenizer (the built tokenizer's pre-tokenizer is not the one tokenizer.json declares: different ids)
rows.note: reproduced on transformers 5.17.0 with the report's script (Hindi text: the published tokenizer.json gives 6 ids, the loaded Qwen2Tokenizer 10); entail on: the expected site was checked and passed - the tokenizer contract ran the declared tokenizer.json against the built tokenizer on its ten fixed probe texts ('10 probe texts encode alike; 33 declared added tokens match'), none of which holds a combining mark (\p{M}), the characters whose pre-tokenization differs; plus an unknown for unread config keys

rows.title: [Bug]: kv_load_failure_policy="recompute" gives wrong output when a KV connector rejects a synchrono
rows.expected_boundary: container:vllm.kv_connector (recompute after a rejected load: the rewound computed-token count reaches the CPU mirror, not the GPU state)
rows.note: reproduced on vLLM 0.30.0 with the report's connector and model (facebook/opt-125m, eager, no prefix caching): the baseline answers ' Rome.', reject-then-recompute gives ' capital of Spain is Madrid.' under sync scheduling and another continuation under async; entail on: unknowns at the config's unread keys, the tokenizer (no tokenizer.json to run) and the chat template, passes at kernel launches and the loader - nothing at the connector's recompute path, the expected site
